entities.name: Botono
entities.description: Helmsman of the Weatherlight under Shanna, later found corrupted and killed by Phyrexian influence; his head was grotesquely transformed.

entities.name: Shanna
entities.description: Captain of the Weatherlight who ended Botono's suffering.

entities.name: Tiana
entities.description: Entered the corrupted Weatherlight with Shanna.

entities.name: Weatherlight
entities.description: Skyship whose crew Botono belonged to; later corrupted by Phyrexia.

entities.name: Bone Dragon
entities.description: Dragon whose attack made the Weatherlight lurch.

events.summary: A bone dragon attacks the Weatherlight and Botono is found injured on the cockpit floor.
events.quote: Botono was found on the floor of the cockpit with a puddle of blood under his head

events.summary: Shanna and Tiana discover Botono's head transformed and attached to a Phyrexian tentacle-like appendage.
events.quote: they discovered Botono’s head, grotesquely transformed and attached to a Phyrexian tentacle-like appendage

events.summary: Shanna ends Botono's suffering by severing the tentacle.
events.quote: Shanna ended his suffering by severing the tentacle

relations.note: Helmsman of the Weatherlight under her.
relations.quote: Botono was the helmsman of the Weatherlight under Shanna .
